name: gb-eli-mcp
description: UK law with verifiable citations: legislation from legislation.gov.uk (search, metadata, text and recent changes, with persistent identifiers), judgments from Find Case Law (The National Archives) and GOV.UK content such as tribunal decisions, HMRC manuals and CMA cases. Every answer carries the official source and identifier, so a citation can be checked instead of trusted. Queries go only to these official UK sources; nothing goes to MateMatic.
